use_evaluating_context_manager: use the evaluating context manager to temporarily switch a PyTorch module to eval mode
move_dict_to_cuda: move all tensor values in a dictionary to the CUDA device using dict_to_cuda
move_dataclass_to_cuda: move all tensor fields of a dataclass to CUDA inplace using dataclass_to_cuda_
concatenate_dataclass_batch: concatenate a batch of dataclasses into one using cat_dataclass with a tensor collator
time_code_with_timer: time a block of code execution using the Timer context manager
